explanation_en: White captures a pawn as an intermediate move before taking the loose rook on c7. This follows the annotated move sequence; the source explanation text appears inconsistent with that line.

intro.popup: 💡 中间招：黑车c4无根是挂子。白方先Rxd6！中间吃兵——黑方应对后，再Rxc7吃回挂车！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Intermezzo: Black's rook on c4 is loose. White first plays Rxd6 as an intermediate capture, then takes the loose rook on c7.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rxd6中间吃兵！黑方应对d6，白方Rxc7吃挂车——连续中间招赢得子力！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rxd6 is the intermediate capture. After Black responds, Rxc7 wins the loose rook and gains material.

moves.popup: 白车Rxd6！中间吃兵——不急着吃c4挂车，先吃d6兵赚子！黑方必须应对！
moves.popup_en: White captures the pawn on d6 as an intermezzo instead of taking the loose rook immediately. Black must respond to the new threat.

moves.popup: 黑车Rb4——c4车撤退，c7棋子守护减弱！
moves.popup_en: The rook moves from c4 to b4, weakening the defense of the piece on c7.

moves.popup: 白车Rxc7！吃掉挂子c7——中间招连续得子，白方大优！
moves.popup_en: White captures the loose piece on c7 with Rxc7, completing the sequence and gaining a large advantage.
